channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Musicians Basil and Belinda seek the perfect lakefront party house; they explore a rustic 6-bedroom retreat with a private beach, a 4-bedroom stunner with a saltwater pool and rooftop deck, and a sleek modern home with a spa-like ensuite and sandy shoreline; which home will hit the right note?
